grain: one row per Pokémon form × type slot (Primary / Secondary)

schema.name: record_kind
schema.description: type_slot = form×type slot rows; base_stat = long stat slice for starter-final panels.

schema.name: type_slot
schema.label: Type slot
schema.description: Primary = Type 1; Secondary = Type 2 when present; null on base_stat rows.

schema.name: type
schema.label: Type (slot)
schema.description: Type for this slot — use with is_primary_form for both-slot participation.

schema.name: archetype
schema.label: Archetype
schema.description: Z-score gap≥1.0, floor≥0.5 on primary-form fit.

schema.name: pool_share_unit
schema.description: 1/n_pool on team-pool primary forms; null elsewhere. Sum by speed_tier → pool share.

schema.name: is_primary_form
schema.description: First CSV row per dex # (base species).

schema.name: is_starter_final
schema.description: Primary-form traditional starter final evolution (18 species, gens 1–6).

schema.name: stat_label
schema.label: Stat
schema.description: Populated on record_kind=base_stat rows for starter-final stat panels.
